name: plimsoll
description: Tells a coding agent what its change did to a local git repository since a base revision: new dependencies, import rings, overly complex functions, committed planning files. Local stdio server from julianzh0/plimsoll; Guard matches only the executable plimsoll. It runs read-only git commands, fetches nothing, sends nothing over the network and writes nothing into the repository. Without a base or a default base in .plimsoll.toml, a question is refused, not guessed. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep the contribution off until a local administrator enables it; plimsoll needs only read access to the repository it is asked about.
Point plimsoll only at repositories an agent may read in full, including their Git history; for a repository that holds restricted files or history, keep the contribution off.
